args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Essentials
- Passport/ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Luggage tags
- Travel adapters (US plug)
- Basic medications

### Clothing
- Lightweight clothing (summer)
- Light jacket/umbrella
- Swimsuits
- Casual outfits for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen (broad-spectrum)
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Insect repellent

### Entertainment
- Books or e-reader
- Travel journal/notebook
- Portable charger
- Camera/phone

### Extras
- Snorkel gear
- Beach umbrella
- Towel
- Extra batteries
- Travel-sized first aid kit
